icons.name: eraser
icons.heading: Eraser
icons.description: The eraser rubs the line out. Light: the eraser presses down onto the line with a stop, sweeps left 11 units in one pass while the line disappears under it, and lifts off at the far end, leaving the short line (v1's end state). Strong: it lifts first, slams down with a bounce, scrubs back and forth in three decaying strokes as it travels, and lifts off with a small hop. The erased length never grows back; the reverse slides it back while the line redraws.

icons.name: ruler-guides
icons.heading: Ruler guides
icons.description: Guides are pulled out of the rulers and set on the 17 marks. Light: the vertical guide is drawn down out of the top ruler, and the horizontal guide follows a beat later, drawn across out of the left ruler; each stops at full length. Strong: each guide is also dragged out from its ruler while it draws, runs past its mark, snaps back onto it with a stop and settles; the horizontal one follows the vertical one. The rulers never move.

icons.description: The scissors snip. Light: the blades ease a touch wider, then snap shut about the hub with a stop (12 degrees each, the handles squeezing together) and spring back open past rest before settling. Strong: snip-snip, two cuts in a row, the second shallower, then a small settle. The rest pose is the open pair; the hub never moves.
